raw_segments.text: Only the other day Stepanita Ilianishna, she's a rich merchant's wife, said to me,
You go, Proharavna, and put your son's name down for prayer in the church and pray for the peace of his soul as though he were dead.
His soul will be troubled, she said, and he will write you a letter.
And Stepanita Ilianishna told me it was a certain thing which had been many times tried.
Oh, you light of ours. Is it true or false, and would it be right?
